test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 28 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

Only two people sit to the left of D. F sits second to the left of D. G sits second to the right of E. E sits second to the right of D. A sits second to the left of B. A is not an immediate neighbour of F.

Who sits at the extreme right end of the line?
solution:
Given: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

1) Only two people sit to the left of D.

2) E sits second to the right of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50d385102e0a4eb62f3b8855ddd346c9299a826711aab2c135ae3ee8965635aa.png] 

3) F sits second to the left of D.

4) G sits second to the right of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f005fae499b614e2bbc0389a77904c2ea3b90f321b6a4c8b0fabf323c7ba412.png] 

5) A sits second to the left of B.

6) A is not an immediate neighbour of F.

After positioning A, B and F only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4dabec774ac462c4ab0a03b94bdc97d0eb7358e414af58d311d9774fab90db6b.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, G sits at the extreme right end of the line.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
